card.text: M50 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 957 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_2323: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 956.50244864 pc (16th to 84th percentile 956 to 957)
Wikipedia, "Messier 50"
sources.quote: Messier 50 or M 50, also known as NGC 2323 or the Heart-shaped Cluster, is an open cluster of stars in the constellation Monoceros.

introduction.text: M50 is drawn as 761 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.

sources.quote: It was recorded by G. D. Cassini before 1711 and independently discovered by Charles Messier in 1772 while observing Biela's Comet.
